definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.179) 'A number used to refer to a specific element of a table, or in the case of the subscript 'ALL', to all elements of a table' and §2023:3.170 ('the value 'ALL'') differ only in wording, so the subscripts SR8 forbids are the same.

definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 (4.163) 'A printed output described in the report section and generated from those data descriptions'; 2023 describes the report in 13.18.46.2. SR8 is confined 'In the report section' in both, so the scope is the same.
